name: Entity Translate Side by Side
description: Provides a side-by-side interface for translating entities in Drupal.
project_description: Edit multiple translations of the same entity side-by-side. The Entity Translate Side by Side module streamlines Drupal entity translations, letting editors view and edit an entity's content in multiple languages next to each other in a single, horizontally scrollable form. It works for any translatable content entity type, adds a 'Translate side by side' entity operation, and only writes back translations that actually changed (preserving translation history and search indexing). Default languages for the interface are configurable at /admin/config/system/entity-translate-side-by-side. Access is gated by the module's own 'access entity translate side by side' permission. Depends on core Content Translation.
